text: Create an account to unlock personalized trip planning, deal alerts, and Atlas — your AI travel concierge
Enter your destination, or click 'Surprise Me' to let Atlas suggest destinations based on your interests and budget
At least 2 interests are required so Atlas knows what to recommend
Set your travel dates, or check 'I'm flexible' to let Atlas find the cheapest dates
Or click 'Let Atlas find the cheapest dates' to let Atlas pick the absolute best deal regardless of timing
Pick activities you enjoy — Atlas uses these to suggest daily itinerary activities
Selecting 'Atlas Recommends' (formerly 'Let Atlas decide') doesn't replace your interests — it tells Atlas to also suggest activities outside your picks if they're a great fit for your destination
Atlas will suggest creating a free account after you've built up your itinerary so you can keep it forever
Build your day-by-day travel plan with Atlas, your AI travel concierge
Atlas searches only when you ask it in chat or tap "Start smart search" — or add items yourself
Ask for flights in chat and Atlas searches live flight prices for your route and dates
Atlas does not have live inventory for these
Ask Atlas anything about your trip — Atlas searches live flight prices, current flight deals, TPI destination guides, and surprise destination ideas
Atlas knows what's already in your itinerary and suggests complementary ideas
If Atlas reaches its monthly usage limit, it pauses until next month and says so honestly

If no destination fits every vibe you picked, Atlas says so honestly and offers real ways forward: match any of your vibes instead of all of them, try a different month, or ask Atlas in chat — it already knows your starting city, month, and vibes
Atlas never fills the gap with made-up destinations or prices
Customize how Atlas and TPI work for you
Atlas uses this to search flights from your location
'Let Atlas decide' works alongside your picks — it tells Atlas to also suggest things outside your selections
Choose how Atlas communicates: concise (quick answers), detailed (thorough explanations), or friendly (casual tone)
The Planner and Atlas search live flight prices once they know your origin and dates, and partner sites show real current prices when you click through
